description: The Book flight and Cancel flight decisions of the Airline Agent Policy, composed with no edges: the policy states no relationship between them that this graph format can carry.

book-flight.description: May this proposed booking be made? Gates a new reservation on the Book flight section; no other node's outcome is an input to it.

cancel-flight.description: May this existing reservation be cancelled? Decided from the reservation's own attributes, not from any outcome of the booking decision.
